synopsis: The metadata request returned a body larger than the configured 128000-byte cap. The probe threw before emitting status or retained partial body, so no supported aliases or endpoint contract can be established.

failures.impact: Status/content type and valid model-list versus HTML fallback are unknown.
failures.fix: Record status, content-type and bounded partial body in protected capture before throwing on oversize. Emit no unreviewed body to engineering. A body-size limit is appropriate, but metadata should remain diagnosable on failure.

recommendations: Have the service owner retain bounded metadata and release only schema-level diagnostics/supportable aliases after reviewer inspection. Do not guess a generation alias from this result.
Verify whether candidate /models is actually a documented LB metadata route; large response may be data or a fallback page and cannot be assumed either way.
limitations: No model alias discovered; no response status retained by current probe; no new inference request made.
